items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We had another bass player that joined us named Epicurean.

ctx.x: Zach White's band in Cincinnati. And he had met the great arranger from McKinney's Cotton Pickers, John Nesbitt. John Nesbitt was the man -- John Nesbitt and Don Redman were the two arrangers that set the style and pace for swing music back in the 20's, late 20's. They did more than any other persons to style the swing music back in that day. More about him a bit later on.
We had another bass player that joined us named Epicurean. Epicurean was -- he played bass horn like you play a trumpet. Genius.
